description: This header file defines the 'CapabilityReportingTask' class within the 'beerocks' namespace. The class manages capabilities reporting in a network agent, including handling messages, events, and adding various capability-related TLVs to messages. It declares several methods for processing capabilities like HT, VHT, HE, WiFi6, CAC, and more.

classes.name: CapabilityReportingTask
classes.description: A class inheriting from Task, responsible for managing capability reports in a network agent, including handling messages, events, and adding specific capability TLVs.

methods.name: handle_cmdu
methods.description: Handles incoming CMDUs, processes them based on interface index, MAC addresses, and header info.

methods.name: handle_event
methods.description: Handles specific events indicated by event_enum_value.

methods.name: add_ap_ht_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HT capabilities TLV to the message if supported on the interface.

methods.name: add_ap_vht_capabilities
methods.description: Adds VHT capabilities TLV to the message if supported on the interface.

methods.name: add_ap_he_capabilities
methods.description: Adds HE capabilities TLV to the message if supported on the interface.

methods.name: add_ap_wifi6_capabilities
methods.description: Adds WiFi6 capabilities TLV to the message if supported on the interface.

methods.name: add_ap_radio_advanced_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds advanced radio capabilities TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_cac_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds CAC capabilities TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_metric_collection_interval_tlv
methods.description: Adds metric collection interval TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_device_inventory_tlv
methods.description: Adds device inventory TLV to the message.

methods.name: add_akm_suites_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds AKM suites capabilities TLV to the provided message.

methods.name: add_wifi7_agent_capabilities_tlv
methods.description: Adds WiFi 7 agent capabilities TLV to the provided message.

methods.name: add_profile2_ap_capability_tlv
methods.description: Adds Profile-2 AP capability TLV to a CMDU message.
